newsitem.title: USA: TGI Friday's enters contract for Vietnam locations.
newsitem.headline: TGI Friday's enters contract for Vietnam locations.

text.p: The T.G.I. Friday's restaurant chain plans to enter a new market: Vietnam.

The restaurant chain's parent company, Friday's Hospitality World Wide Inc., announced Tuesday that it had entered an agreement with Ellisford Investments Ltd. to develop T.G.I. Friday -- short for "Thank God It's Friday" -- restaurants in the former U.S. foe.
Under the agreement, which covers all of Vietnam, the first of the casual restaurants is slated to open in December 1997, the company said.

Friday's also signed agreements to develop restaurants in Indonesia with PT Tri Saga Sarama, the company said. That agreement calls for the development of seven T.G.I. Friday's restaurants, five Italianni's restaurants and one Friday's Front Row Sports Grill in the archipelagan country over the next five years.
Friday's plans to have 500 domestic restaurants and more than 200 international resturants in six continents by the year 2000, the company said said.
Friday's Hospitality, a unit of Carlson Cos. Inc., operates, franchises and licenses more than 395 T.G.I. Fridays, Italianni's and Front Row Sports Grill restaurants.
